SILO CUT DECALS

Silo cut decals stand out as an ideal choice for promotional graphics and specialized applications. Comprising cutout pieces, these decals offer versatility for both permanent and temporary installations. They also enable you to seamlessly incorporate text, logos, or decals while preserving the visual continuity of your space, making them a practical and visually appealing solution.

WINDOW GRAPHICS & BRANDING

A powerful tool for businesses and elements on windows to convey a specific message, promote a brand, or enhance the overall aesthetics of a space. These can be applied to various types of windows, including those in retail stores, offices, vehicles, or any other location where a window is present. Whether you’re looking for a long-lasting branding solution or a short-term promotional message, window graphics offer a cost-effective and impactful means of visual communication.

DECORATIVE FROST WINDOW FILM

A stylish and functional solution that not only enhances privacy but also adds a decorative touch and visual interest to your glass surfaces. This film is often used on windows and glass doors in both residential and commercial settings.

PRIVACY AND SAFETY FILMS

These films offer a multifaceted solution to address privacy concerns, enhance safety, and improve overall comfort in your living or working spaces. Achieve Privacy Enhancement, Safety and Security, UV Protection, Anti-Glare Properties, Shatter Resistance, and versatility — all without compromising natural light.

ADA & WAYFINDING SIGNS

These are architectural signs that comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act, these include tactile elements like raised letters and Braille, high contrast between text and background, and standardized pictograms for easy recognition. Wayfinding signs form a system designed to guide individuals through complex environments facilitating easy navigation. Integrating ADA signs into wayfinding systems ensures that information is universally accessible.

3M DI-NOC ARCHITECTURAL FINISHES

A series of vinyl films designed for architectural and interior design applications. Known for their versatility, these finishes offer a wide variety of designs, patterns, and textures that mimic natural materials such as wood, metal, stone, fabric, and more. With durability against wear and tear, scratches, and fading, DI-NOC Architectural Finishes are suitable for high-traffic areas, ensuring long-lasting aesthetics in various design projects.

SEG
(Silicone Edge Graphics)

SEG (Silicone Edge Graphics) are cutting-edge solutions in visual displays and signage. SEG involves a fabric graphic with a replaceable silicone edge, fitting seamlessly into a frame for dynamic updates. Ideal for retail, trade shows, interior decor, and brand promotions, this solution offers versatility in visual communication.

CLEAT MOUNT & STANDOFF SIGNS

Both cleat mount and standoff signs offer a modern and stylish approach to signage, providing businesses and organizations with an elegant way to display important information, branding, or directional guidance. Cleat mount sign is mounted to the wall using a cleat, creating a visually appealing floating effect. Standoff signs achieve a three-dimensional effect by elevating the sign away from the wall using decorative standoffs. This not only adds visual interest but also allows for backlighting options.

FLOOR GRAPHICS

Wall murals transform plain walls into captivating displays for decorative or branding purposes. Meanwhile, durable and slip-resistant floor graphics serve practical functions for wayfinding, advertising, and brand promotion.

DRY ERASE WALLPAPER

A wallcovering designed for versatile use in professional environments. It features a specialized vinyl or laminate material with a smooth coating that allows users to write, draw, and erase directly on the surface. This innovative solution provides a practical alternative to traditional whiteboards, offering integration into offices, conference rooms, and collaborative spaces. With its superior erasability and resistance to ghosting, dry erase wallpaper ensures clear and crisp writing experiences for brainstorming sessions, presentations, and daily task management.

ACOUSTIC PANEL & WALLCOVERING

Consists of specialized materials engineered to reduce noise levels in interior spaces. Made from foam, fabric, or cork, it absorbs sound waves and minimizes reverberation. With features like perforations or embossed patterns, it enhances its sound-absorbing properties. Ideal for offices, conference rooms, and residential areas, acoustic wallpaper creates a quieter and more comfortable environment.

CASPER CLOAKING FILM

Casper Cloaking Technology: an innovative architectural film designed for glass walls,
meticulously crafted to obscure digital screens from external view. With its sophisticated
shielding capabilities, Casper ensures the utmost data privacy while facilitating seamless
collaboration in any professional setting. Fundamentally, Casper employs advanced
light-blocking mechanisms to render LED and LCD screens imperceptible to observers
outside the room. Applied discreetly to the interior surface of glass walls, Casper
preserves transparency while guaranteeing confidentiality.
